info.title: Areal Copilot Agents API
info.description: Endpoints used to list Copilot agents, read their status, read their tasks and change those tasks. Companion to the Areal Copilot Agents API integration guide.

patch.description: Rename a task. Doesn't change its plan or results.

post.description: Override a failed task result on one loan as 'success' or 'n/a', or remove an existing override. The caller becomes the assigned user.
